crossRefs.note: The high priest stood up, and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”
Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”
Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have…

parallels.note: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”
He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”
translations.bsb: Then Pilate questioned Him again, “Have You no answer? Look how many charges they are bringing against You!”
translations.kjv: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
translations.asv: And Pilate again asked him, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they accuse thee of.
